title: Project-OS project configuration
description: The nine keys that parameterize the Project-OS skills. Anything not here stays literal in the skill.

tier.description: Decides which OS pieces activate (PROJECT_OS.md Part 7). solo: no board, no queue, no committer hooks.

repo.description: owner/name. Replaces the repo slug hardcoded into every tracker command.

tracker.description: Where the handoff queue lives. 'none' MUST degrade to a file-based queue at docsPath + handoffs/, never break.

verify.description: The command that must pass before a handoff and at session close. Exit 0 = green. IT RUNS UNDER execSync FROM THE REPO ROOT, which means the platform's default shell: cmd.exe on Windows, /bin/sh elsewhere. A command that works in your terminal can still fail here — './gradlew ...' is the case that bit a real adopter, where the test suite was green and the watchdog read red. If the command needs a specific shell, a wrapper script or an absolute interpreter path, put that in this value; the doctor and the watchdog both run it exactly this way, so a mismatch surfaces as a config FAIL rather than as a mystery.

commitStyle.description: numbered = 'NN - description' with the uniqueness guard (BEHAVIOR 7.4); conventional = free subject.

owner.description: Who 'needs owner action' points at in a handoff body.

lanes.description: Team names offered in a handoff body. Empty at solo tier.

docsPath.description: Where the artifact set lives. Some projects use documentation/ or an external wiki.

notesPath.description: The workbench (PROJECT_OS.md 3.22): the one directory where writing is allowed to be wrong. Excluded from freshness as a class — no file under it is ever a finding. Default notes/; set any name, e.g. notas/, so a team is not forced into English.

notesFolders.description: Names for the six kind folders of the workbench (PROJECT_OS.md 3.22, Shape), in the project's language. Keys are the kinds and never change; values are folder names. Missing keys keep the English default.

autoInject.description: Whether the SessionStart injector is active. True asserts it is registered AND an injection has been observed — presence is not registration.
